title: Desk Crawler companion: hero page structure
question: Three layouts for the new hero page, all in the existing 1-bit e-ink look. Each carries the live TRMNL preview, the since-last-visit summary with countdowns, lifetime records with rank, and a grouped, filterable log. Pick the structure to build, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Desk and feed
options.lineage: your desk beside its own logbook
options.thesis: The TRMNL screen is the anchor; everything else is the story of how it got there.
options.viewport: Phone: the live device preview fills the width with layout tabs (full, half, quadrant) and a 'next adventure in 7 min' strip on its bezel; directly below, the since-you-left ledger (XP, gold, fights, finds, level-ups). Desktop: the device pins in a left pane while the feed scrolls on the right.
options.risk: The preview dominates the first screen, so the hero's controls (travel, potion, pause) sit one scroll lower.

options.label: The now line
options.lineage: a shift timeline pinned at the present
options.thesis: One vertical timeline split at NOW: what's about to happen above, what happened below.
options.viewport: Phone: compact header (scene thumbnail, name, level, HP/XP); the NOW marker with a live countdown; above it the upcoming beats (next tick, arrival, revival); below it a 'since your last visit' band, then encounters grouped by tick with deltas. The device preview and records open from the header.
options.risk: The preview and lifetime records live behind header controls rather than on the page itself.

options.label: Status board
options.thesis: Answer 'how is my hero doing?' in one glance of labelled rows, then dive into tabs.
options.viewport: Phone: the scene, then a board of rows: STATUS Exploring Server Room · NEXT ADVENTURE 07:12 · RANK #3 of 41 · HP 118/136 · BAG 17/30 · SINCE YOU LEFT +412 XP. Below, tabs switch between TRMNL preview, Log and Records; actions sit under the board.
options.risk: Tabs hide two of the three deep views at any moment, so less is visible at once.
